chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn Asbat from Muhammad ibn Humran from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who comes to his wife from behind (in her rear), he said: There is no harm if she is pleased.
I said: Then where is the saying of Allah, the Exalted: 'So come to them from where Allah has commanded you'?

He said: This [command] is regarding seeking offspring. So seek offspring from where Allah has commanded you. Indeed Allah, the Exalted, says: 'Your wives are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth as you wish'.

key_terms.حَرْثٌ: tilth (metaphor for the wife's body in Quran 2:223)
key_terms.دُبُرِهَا: her rear (referring to posterior/vaginal intercourse from behind)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to have intercourse with his wife from behind according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Istibsar*, Shaykh al-Tusi records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) resolution of the apparent tension between the general permissibility of marital intimacy and the specific Quranic metaphor of 'tilth' (2:223). The Imam clarifies that the verse’s directive to 'come to your tilth as you are commanded' primarily governs the location for procreation, whereas the broader principle allows for sexual relations from behind provided the wife consents, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on mutual agreement and flexibility in marital relations.
